As of the most recent available evidence, the 2024 Spiel des Jahres (German Game of the Year) was won by Sky Team, a cooperative two-player game in which players act as pilot and co-pilot working together to land an airliner [d5][d3]. This was announced on July 21, 2024, with d3 explicitly noting "Spiel des Jahres 2024 (family game of the year): SKY TEAM" [d3]. Several earlier sources (d1, d6, d8) had identified Dorfromantik: The Board Game as the most recent winner, having taken the 2023 award, but this information has since been superseded [d6][d8]. Sky Team is also notable as the first two-player game to win the Spiel des Jahres in the award's history [d5].
